data.name: FAVORS
data.detailed_description:
FAVORS is a player-first turn-based strategy game with a divine twist.

You're a hero! Build your base, recruit powerful units, and outmaneuver opponents on various hexagonal battlefields. Complete missions to please capricious gods and earn divine favors that can radically change the course of battle!

Key features include:

  • Simple rules, countless possibilities — approachable to new players, but endlessly deep for strategic minds

  • Play your way — Dominate solo, challenge friends in multiplayer duels, or form unstoppable teams. Host your own games for LAN play or battle online against the world's best strategists. Our time storage mechanic lets you set your own pace during 30-35 min tactical showdowns.

  • Focus on wisdom over reflexes — no twitch mechanics, only thoughtful decisions.

  • Community-driven : Create custom maps, organize epic tournaments, and participate in community events. FAVORS isn't just a game, it's a platform for competitive strategy enthusiasts to showcase their tactical brilliance.

  • Divine twists — unexpected favors or jealous hindrances from the gods keep battles fresh and unpredictable.
